purpose: Lock the exact market-isolated H2 data snapshot, ridge/partial-pooling implementation, penalties, held-out validation procedure and 2026 release construction before reading the 2025 validation metrics.

sourceSnapshot.rule: The full external asset must match the pinned SHA-256 before any field is read. Only whitelisted fields may be written to the durable H2 snapshot.

marketIsolation.rule: H2 code must select fields by positive whitelist; presence of sportsbook fields in the upstream file is irrelevant because they are never loaded into the model record.

validation.rule: No HFA coefficient or regularization parameter may be changed after reading 2025 metrics. Validation-only team-strength nuisance coefficients may be estimated from 2025 score margins using a common league-only HFA offset shared by the candidate and league-only comparison; this does not refit any candidate HFA coefficient.

features.teamSeasonStrength: +1 for home team-season and -1 for away team-season on every completed game
features.seasonHomeDeviation: one indicator for the game's season when location=Home
features.teamVenueHomeDeviation: one indicator for normalized home-team + stadium identity when location=Home

visitorRoadDeviation.rule: H2 v1 does not add a second visitor-road random effect because it is substantially collinear with team-season strength and home-team/venue effects.

nextSeasonLeagueBaselineForecast.rule: For a next-season forecast use the global ridge baseline plus the weighted average of the three most recent fitted season HFA deviations.

teamVenueProjection.rule: A known 2026 domestic team/stadium pair receives its fitted persistent team-venue deviation. A team/stadium pair unseen in the completed fit receives zero deviation and NEW_VENUE uncertainty rather than inheriting an old stadium's full effect.

model.stadiumKey: Use stadium_id when present; otherwise normalized stadium text. Pair it with normalized home-team code.

validationProcedure.leagueOnlyForecast: Use the locked 2021-2024 next-season league baseline forecast with zero team-venue deviations.
validationProcedure.candidateForecast: Use the same league baseline plus frozen 2021-2024 team-venue deviations for 2025 stadium pairs seen in training; unseen pairs receive zero deviation.
validationProcedure.holdoutStrengthNuisance: Estimate 2025 team-strength coefficients once after subtracting the league-only domestic HFA forecast. Reuse those exact strengths for both the league-only and candidate residual evaluation.
validationProcedure.evaluationRows: All completed 2025 REG games; domestic-home metrics are primary and neutral-site residual bias is reported separately.

finalReleaseConstruction.2026LeagueBaseline: Apply the locked next-season baseline forecast to the refit through 2025.
finalReleaseConstruction.2026VenueIdentity: Resolve each team's modal location=Home stadium from 2026 schedule rows. If no governed domestic stadium is resolvable, mark UNRESOLVED and do not invent a team HFA.
finalReleaseConstruction.displayGuidance: H2 never rounds or mutates the live Graham board; H3 will preserve exact HFA arithmetic before ordinary half-point Graham display rounding.

venueClassificationRules.DOMESTIC_HOME: 2026 location=Home and stadium identity is resolvable for the designated home team.
venueClassificationRules.NEUTRAL: 2026 location=Neutral; HFA base is zero in H3 unless a separately governed local differential is later approved.
venueClassificationRules.NEW_VENUE: 2026 domestic home team/stadium pair not observed in 2021-2025 completed training/refit rows.
venueClassificationRules.SHARED_VENUE_OR_METRO: Not inferred automatically in H2; flag for H3 explicit game review when opposing clubs share a stadium/metro context.
venueClassificationRules.RELOCATED_HOME: Not inferred from designation alone; H3 must review when a current game is moved from the team's modal governed home venue.
venueClassificationRules.UNRESOLVED: No reliable 2026 domestic home venue identity; fail closed in H3.

h3EntryGate: external source SHA matches the pinned H2 contract
2025 chronological HFA holdout passes the locked acceptance thresholds
32-team 2026 registry is finite or explicitly unresolved
no live Graham, personnel, player-value or carried-rating artifact changed
